summary: Join our training course on regulatory risks in pension plans. Gain essential insights and strategies to tackle challenges in the ever-evolving landscape.
lede: Regulatory risk training for pension plans helps pension and benefits professionals assess compliance risks across a plan’s lifecycle. It covers interpreting pension rules, mapping risks to controls, and reviewing governance, funding, investments, member communications and reporting so trustees, administrators, and HR or risk teams can identify gaps and plan practical action.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who are responsible for, or closely involved with, pension plans and retirement benefits, and who must understand regulatory expectations and manage related risks. This course is designed for: Pension fund managers and administrators. HR and benefits managers overseeing employee retirement schemes. Trustees and board members of pension and retirement plans. Compliance and risk officers in pension funds, insurers, and financial institutions. Public sector staff managing statutory or occupational retirement schemes. NGO and international organization staff responsible for staff pension plans. Actuarial and finance professionals supporting pension design and oversight. Legal, internal audit, or governance professionals reviewing pension compliance. Regulators or supervisory staff seeking a practitioner’s view of pension risks. Any professional who must understand and manage regulatory risks in pension and retirement benefit plans.
modules: Mapping Regulatory Risks Across the Pension Plan Lifecycle
Governance, Fiduciary Duties, and Trustee Responsibilities
Funding, Solvency, and Regulatory Capital Expectations
Investment Regulations and Risk Controls for Pension Assets
Member Protection, Disclosure, and Communication Duties
Operational and Administrative Risks in Pension Plans
Regulatory Reporting, Audits, and Supervisory Engagement
Emerging Trends and Future Challenges in Pension Regulation
Building a Practical Pension Regulatory Risk Action Plan
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of pension plans and a role related to pension management or oversight. No prior legal expertise is required.
